meta.title: Contact & Enquiries
meta.description: Plan a guided nature trip with Wildora Expeditions. Send an enquiry on WhatsApp with your trip, dates, group size and any dietary or medical needs.

head.title: Plan your trip <accent>with us</accent>
head.lede: Tell us what you would like to see, when you can travel and who is coming.

next.heading: What happens next
next.sendForm: You send the form (or your WhatsApp message).
next.sendWhatsApp: You check the message in WhatsApp and send it.
next.reply: We reply with availability, a suggested plan and how to confirm your place.
next.beforeBooking: Before you book, you tell us about any medical condition or allergy, and arrange travel medical insurance.

before.heading: Before you write
before.body: Many questions about seasons, fitness, food, insurance and what to bring are already answered.

form.intro: Fields marked <star>*</star> are required. Fill in as much or as little of the rest as you like.
form.errorSummary: Please check {count, plural, one {the field} other {the # fields}} marked below.

placeholders.diet: e.g. vegan, no spicy food, nut allergy
placeholders.message: What would you like to see or do? Your pace, comfort level, wish-list species, any questions…

hints.medical: We need to know about any medical condition, allergy or mobility limitation before you book. See <link>health & insurance</link>.

other: Not sure yet: please help me choose

errors.name: Please enter your name.
errors.message: Please write a short message so we know how to help.
errors.groupSize: Group size must be a whole number, 1 or more.
errors.consent: Please tick the box so we can receive your enquiry.

form.consent: I agree that Wildora Expeditions may use what I have written, including any health or dietary details, to reply to this enquiry. I can withdraw this at any time. See the <link>privacy notice</link>.
form.whatsappNotice: By sending, you agree that Wildora Expeditions may contact you on WhatsApp about this enquiry. This website does not store anything you type: the form only writes the message, and you choose whether to send it from your own WhatsApp. See the <link>privacy notice</link>.

opensNote.form: WhatsApp opens in a new tab, to {number}.
opensNote.whatsapp: Opens WhatsApp in a new tab, to {number}.

status.ok: Thank you. Your enquiry has been sent and we will reply with availability and a suggested plan.
status.error: Sorry, your enquiry could not be sent. Nothing was lost: you can try again, or use WhatsApp instead.
status.errorWithEmail: Sorry, your enquiry could not be sent. Nothing was lost: you can try again, or use WhatsApp or email instead.
status.sent: WhatsApp should now be open in a new tab with your message filled in. Press send there to reach us. Nothing opened? <link>Open WhatsApp with my message</link>

message.greeting: Hello Wildora, I would like to enquire about a trip.
message.footer: (Sent from the enquiry form on the Wildora website)
message.subject: Trip enquiry from {name}
